name: Newport Children's Theatre Summer Theatre Camps
description_short: Newport Children's Theatre runs summer theatre camps for ages 8-18 at its studio in Middletown, RI. Past camps have put on musicals and plays such as Something Rotten and Anne of Green Gables.
